lines: I drink the loneliness
I come to know the pain
I vomit my weakness
I keep the strength
And yet it is not enough
Alone, at the edge of a world gone astray
I clutch the solitude and walk on today
Even the pain has grown cold to the bone
In the heart of a deep, dark night
By the weight of what I bear
I feel today crushing me
And still I wish for tomorrow
So today as well
I drink the loneliness, I know the pain
I vomit my weakness, I keep the strength
And yet it still falls short
I even brushed away the outstretched hand
What remains at the bottom is weakness
Even loneliness gives birth to strength
I tell myself that and cling to today
This heart that kept deceiving
Turns a blind eye even to the creaking sounds
If I cling, I cannot let go
I fear becoming fragile
I paint over the phantom in the mirror, then break it again
And to the you who has vanished
I can no longer lean on
I drink the loneliness, I know the pain
I vomit my weakness, I keep the strength
And yet it still falls short
I even brushed away the outstretched hand
And yet it still falls short
I sold even your heart
I even killed your pain
Dawn is coming soon
